title: US Economic Diplomacy With Allies Becomes an Election Showcase for Trump
author: Austin Sparbel
text:
U.S. Senator Dan Sullivan (blue tie) speaks while standing next to U.S. President Donald Trump during an event announcing new investment for the Alaska LNG pipeline, Sep. 30, 2026.
Credit: Official White House Photo by Daniel Torok
On September 28, Trump invited Iowa Representative Ashley Hinson, the Republican running for an open Senate seat, to the Oval Office to announce a new $15 billion steel plant in her home state, which is being built by the local subsidiary of an Indian conglomerate. Two days later, with Alaska Senator Dan Sullivan standing beside him, Trump announced roughly $54 billion in prospective South Korean investment in the Alaska LNG pipeline. Notably, both announcements came a little over a month before the midterm elections. The Associated Press noted that it was “the second time in three days” Trump had paired a major investment announcement with a Republican Senate candidate in a race that had become unexpectedly competitive.[...]
